description:
Beautiful Design

This bike is an absolute eye-catcher. It has a retro chic design and is available in three colours: pink and green, making it a fantastic experience for your child.

Suitable range

Our 14-inch children's bike is suitable for children with a height of 92-120 cm, the 16-inch children's bike for children with a height of 105-135 cm and the 18-inch children's bike for children with a height of 115-145 cm. The minimum height of the saddle from the ground: 14 inch bike - 535 mm, 16 inch bike - 550 mm, 18 inch bike - 610 mm.

Optimal safety protection

All our bicycles are equipped with hand and foot brake - two separate brake systems - to ensure the safety of your child. Chain guard and handlebar edge protection ensure your child's safety, and the saddle height can be adjusted to suit your child's growth.
Rear coaster brake provides dependable control as needed, and simply pedals backwards to stop.

90% pre-assembled

The bike comes 90% pre-assembled, so all you need to do is complete simple assembly steps. The tool required for assembly is included in the packaging.

CUSTOMER SERVICE

If you have any questions about your bike, please contact us via Amazon or our email. Our customer service team will get back to you within 24 hours on business days.

Ins Star is a kids' bike designed with children's safety in mind by Hiland. Featuring a vintage trendy design with the mint green/pink paint, it is absolutely eye-catching and brings a dreamy experience to the little rider. It is easy to handle and quick to get started, contributing to the child's confidence in riding. As an ideal choice for learning to ride, it is just waiting for little heroes to take it to the park and streets and start their riding journeys!
